question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one that follows the same logic.

BORE - EOBR - ORBE

RUST - TURS - USRT
solution:
The logic followed here is:

BORE - EOBR - ORBE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55c881c74e13e1ad0a4034fb78bfc8af0ca7c84ba06a3836f3c756cf2a29264f.png] 

RUST - TURS - USRT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f268c167ff953de5938d98ef556663016a271ee1dcaf01d5da1feed7ee100e29.png] 

Similarly,

**Option 4) JUSL - LUJS - USJL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1338449650d7e6b9a46a06e7442ff6a13e45c9f5e552f1a2a2f2d4f4e7a36046.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
